first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and shortening onboarding has previously improved time-to-value and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding and activation evidence before committing, while avoiding broad promotional pricing because its prior revenue lift came with materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Use the single weekly slot to test in-product activation messaging, which previously increased activation by 6%, week-one engagement by 11%, and 30-day retention by 1%. This directly addresses the current activation decline without the retention risk of promotional pricing. Do not shorten onboarding broadly: its churn increase is concentrated in complex-workspace accounts. Keep the activation test measured by qualified activation, retention, and downstream revenue.
